title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.

description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.


Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.


Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Inspecionar as não conformidades em equipamentos e processos;
  • Atribuir as atividades diárias do setor;
  • Acompanhar a contratação dos colaboradores para o setor;
  • Treinar colaboradores nas atividades do setor e rotinas operacionais;
  • Verificar as atividades diárias;
  • Avaliar os colaboradores atribuindo feedback para o time operacional;
  • Solicitar manutenções corretivas preventivas e melhorias;
  • Controlar os EPIs para colaboradores do setor além de itens de dia-a-dia como canetas, panos, água, etc.;
  • Administrar a gestão dos tanques de MP, insumos e produtos;
  • Aplicar serviços fora da rotina que envolva APRs ou trabalhos críticos;
  • Acompanhar as reuniões;
  • Administrar a gestão dos indicadores do seu turno;
  • Executar atividades correlatas conforme as orientações de seu gestor.


Instrução:

Formação concluída em um dos cursos abaixo:

  • Eng. Química;
  • Eng. de Alimentos;
  • Engenharia Industrial.


Necessário:

  • Proficiência em informática;
  • Carteira de Registro no Conselho Regional atualizada.


Desejável:

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos na área industrial.


Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. title: Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "Data Engineer" Remote mode ,who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


  • Snowflake, DBT, SQL
  • Proficient in English
  • Agile Methodologies;
  • Operational Monitoring: Proactively monitor data jobs and pipelines to ensure smooth execution and timely delivery of datasets. Respond to alerts and resolve issues with minimal downtime.
  • Pipeline Maintenance: Maintain and enhance DBT models and SQL scripts to support evolving business needs and ensure data accuracy.
  • Warehouse Operations: Oversee Snowflake operations including user access, query performance, and resource utilization.
  • Incident Response: Act as a first responder for data job failures, conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive measures.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to support operational data needs and troubleshoot issues.
  • Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks, improve pipeline efficiency, and reduce operational overhead.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Maintain clear documentation of operational procedures, job schedules, and incident logs. Provide regular updates to stakeholders on system health and performance.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

Health insurance

Gympass

title: Líder Técnico Salesforce
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital.

Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Líder Técnico Salesforce


Buscamos um Líder Técnico Salesforce para atuar como referência dentro da empresa, garantindo a excelência técnica da plataforma e apoiando o time de negócios na tradução de requisitos em soluções escaláveis e eficientes. Esse profissional será responsável por transformar histórias de negócios em escopo técnico, apoiar a gestão do backlog e assegurar a performance, segurança e governança do ambiente Salesforce.


Principais Responsabilidades

Atuar como referência técnica em Salesforce, orientando o time e apoiando na tomada de decisão estratégica.

Refinar histórias de negócio, transformando em histórias técnicas e requisitos claros para implementação.

Apoiar o PM na escrita e detalhamento das histórias de usuário.

Administrar as orgs Salesforce, incluindo controle de usuários, permissões, configurações e integrações.

Gerenciar storage, capacidade e performance do ambiente Salesforce.

Garantir boas práticas de segurança, governança e compliance dentro da plataforma.

Apoiar iniciativas de integração com outras tecnologias.

Atuar próximo das áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em soluções técnicas robustas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida em Administração e Configuração Salesforce.

Conhecimento em Salesforce Service Cloud, Sales Cloud e integrações via API.

Habilidade para refinar histórias de usuário em backlog técnico.

Vivência em gestão de capacidade, storage e performance de Salesforce.

Experiência como ponto de referência técnica em projetos Salesforce.

Proatividade, visão crítica e capacidade de liderar discussões técnicas.


Requisitos Desejáveis

Desejável o conhecimento em desenvolvimento .NET.

Certificações Salesforce (Admin, Advanced Admin, Platform App Builder ou similares).

Experiência com DevOps Salesforce (CI/CD, Git, ferramentas de versionamento).

title: Market Data Infrastructure Engineer (LATAM)
description:
IMPORTANT: Eligible locations in LATAM: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico.


Company Description

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Our Client

Our client is one of the world's leading investment banks, founded in the 19th century, offers a broad range of services, including investment banking, securities trading, and asset management. It specializes in advising on mergers, acquisitions, and capital-raising activities for major corporations and governments. Known for its strong presence in global financial markets, the firm provides market-making and trading services across various asset classes. It has earned a reputation for shaping the financial landscape on Wall Street and beyond. The organization is also committed to philanthropy and sustainability through its various initiatives and programs.


Role Description

We are looking for a skilled professional to join our Market Data Infrastructure team, focused on managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues.
  • Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements.
  • Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues.
  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience

• Experience with Market Data Thomson Reuters Enterprise Platform (TREP) or Refinitiv Real-Time Distribution System (RTDS) and DACS .

• Good understanding of Market Data platforms e.g. Refinitiv, Bloomberg, direct feed providers.

• Proficient with Linux/ Windows operating systems and network level tuning and editing scripts - preferred scripting language: Bash/Python.

• Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.

• Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must

• Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices

• Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:

o Geneos ITRS

o EXEGY (formerly Wombat/Vela)

o Market Data API

o AWS ECS, AWS VPC, including VPC Endpoints


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented company
  • Remote work, or Hybrid based on candidates’ preferences
  • Continuous development and training opportunities
  • A competitive salary package with additional social benefits
  • Interesting and challenging tasks
  • The opportunity to work in an international and multicultural environment
  • Regular team events
  • Long-term career prospects

  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience

• Experience with Market Data Thomson Reuters Enterprise Platform (TREP) or Refinitiv Real-Time Distribution System (RTDS) and DACS .

• Good understanding of Market Data platforms e.g. Refinitiv, Bloomberg, direct feed providers.

• Proficient with Linux/ Windows operating systems and network level tuning and editing scripts - preferred scripting language: Bash/Python.

• Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.

• Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must

• Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices

• Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:

o Geneos ITRS

o EXEGY (formerly Wombat/Vela)

o Market Data API

o AWS ECS, AWS VPC, including VPC Endpoints


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented company
  • Remote work, or Hybrid based on candidates’ preferences
  • Continuous development and training opportunities
  • A competitive salary package with additional social benefits
  • Interesting and challenging tasks
  • The opportunity to work in an international and multicultural environment
  • Regular team events
  • Long-term career prospects

description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Assistant for Law Firms


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: Profissional Tech Lead Java e Kotlin
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- Quais as experiência você deve ter:


  • Skills Técnicas: Arquitetura de Sistemas Complexos: Expertise em design de arquiteturas distribuídas, microserviços e sistemas de alta disponibilidade Java/Kotlin Avançado:
  • Domínio profundo do ecossistema JVM, Spring Framework, frameworks reativos (WebFlux, Reactor) e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Engenharia de Dados: Conhecimento sólido em pipelines de dados, processamento em tempo real/batch, e integração entre sistemas de dados e aplicações AWS Cloud Native:
  • Experiência avançada com serviços AWS (ECS, EKS, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, Kinesis, SQS, SNS) e padrões cloud-native DevOps e Infraestrutura: Proficiência em CI/CD, containerização (Docker/Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) Observabilidade: Expertise em monitoring, logging, tracing e métricas (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Jaeger)
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento avançado em SQL/NoSQL, otimização de queries e estratégias de persistência Competências de Liderança Humanizada: Mentoria Transformadora: Capacidade de identificar potenciais individuais e criar planos de desenvolvimento personalizados para cada membro da equipe
  • Facilitação de Conflitos: Habilidade para mediar divergências técnicas e interpessoais, transformando tensões em oportunidades de crescimento Comunicação Multinível: Expertise em traduzir complexidades técnicas para diferentes audiências (equipe, stakeholders, gestores) de forma clara e inspiradora
  • Delegação Inteligente: Capacidade de distribuir responsabilidades considerando tanto as necessidades do projeto quanto o desenvolvimento individual de cada pessoa Feedback Construtivo: Habilidade para dar e receber feedback de forma empática, focando no crescimento e na melhoria contínua
  • Liderança de Equipes Técnicas: Mínimo 3 anos liderando equipes de desenvolvimento (5-10 pessoas) Transformação de Equipes: Experiência em reestruturação, upskilling e melhoria de processos de desenvolvimento Projetos de Grande Escala: Participação em projetos que processam alto volume de dados ou atendem milhões de usuários Cultura DevOps: Experiência na implementação de práticas DevOps e cultura de responsabilidade compartilhada Metodologias Ágeis: Proficiência em Scrum, Kanban e práticas de desenvolvimento ágil


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

title: Calypso Technical Analyst
description:
Why Join Qaracter


Qaracter is an international consulting firm specialized in the financial and banking sector. We partner with leading institutions to drive transformation projects across compliance, technology, operations, and risk management.


With a global mindset and strong expertise in financial services, we help our clients face complex challenges and design innovative solutions.


What powers it all? Our people — ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.



What You’ll Do

  • Work with Calypso for system development and support
  • Integrate and manage APIs (REST, FIX, SWIFT, XML)
  • Support the trade lifecycle and related workflows
  • Utilize AWS cloud services and CI/CD practices
  • Develop using Java and SQL


What You Bring

  • Minimum 3 years of experience with Calypso
  • Strong knowledge in API development and support
  • Hands-on experience with Java development and SQL
  • Familiarity with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, FIX, Swift, XML protocols


Location

LATAM (Remote)


Your Benefits at Qaracter

  • Opportunity to work on international financial projects.
  • Flexibility: remote, hybrid, or in-office options depending on the client.
  • Recognition and referral programs.
  • Ongoing learning and training opportunities with reimbursement options.
  • Well-being program and team events.
  • Competitive compensation and top-tier equipment provision.



At QARACTER Group, we are committed to ensuring equal opportunities and non-discrimination in all our processes, promoting an inclusive and diverse work environment. All applications are welcome regardless of sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, age, disability, or any other personal or social condition, in line with our Plan de Igualdad and our commitment to equity.

title: Product Designer Specialist
description:
Como Product Design Specialist na área de IA da Sankhya, você terá um papel estratégico na evolução da BIA, nossa Business Intelligence Assistant.


Sua missão será atuar como referência técnica em design de produto, aplicando metodologias e boas práticas que assegurem soluções consistentes, inovadoras e centradas no usuário. Contribuir ativamente para a entrega de produtos de alta qualidade, conectando necessidades do negócio e experiência do usuário, além de apoiar a evolução contínua do processo de design dentro da organização.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Definir e sustentar a visão e a estratégia de design de produto, alinhadas aos objetivos de longo prazo da empresa.
  • Liderar projetos estratégicos e de alto impacto, influenciando diretamente a direção dos produtos e a experiência do usuário.
  • Ser referência técnica e ponto de contato para decisões críticas relacionadas ao design de produto em toda a organização.
  • Apoiar e coordenar múltiplos times de design, garantindo consistência e evolução das práticas de design.
  • Conduzir iniciativas de melhoria contínua em processos, ferramentas e frameworks de design.
  • Representar o time de design em fóruns estratégicos, interações com a alta gestão e stakeholders externos.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Domínio de metodologias de design estratégico, inovação e práticas centradas no usuário.
  • Experiência consolidada em liderança técnica e gestão de projetos complexos de design.
  • Clareza em identificar a entrega de valor, com capacidade de mapear e analisar jornadas do usuário de ponta a ponta.
  • Amplo conhecimento sobre tendências emergentes em tecnologia, UX, UI e inovação digital.
  • Capacidade de storytelling para comunicar visões e soluções complexas a diferentes públicos.
  • Habilidade para equilibrar entregas de curto prazo com visão estratégica de longo prazo.



Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: SAP Mobile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Analista de mídias sociais
description:
Social Media da Gamers Brawl

Você respira redes sociais e é um(a) gamer? Sabe transformar uma jogada insana em conteúdo de impacto? Acha que o feed de uma marca gamer não pode ser genérico e precisa ser tão épico quanto um Pentakill?

Então talvez essa vaga seja sua!

O que esperamos de você:
  • Domínio das redes sociais (Instagram, YouTube, Twitter e TikTok);
  • Criatividade pra transformar momentos da comunidade e dos embaixadores em posts virais;
  • Conhecimento em edição de imagens (Photoshop, Canva, ou similares);
  • Experiência com jogos (principalmente League of Legends — sim, saber o que é um “gank” conta pontos);
  • Capacidade de interagir com a comunidade com tom leve, afiado e divertido;
  • Organização pra manter o calendário de publicações em dia e construir ideias novas pros nossos conteúdos.


Diferenciais:
  • Saber o que tá rolando no cenário gamer e nos eSports;
  • Ter noção de edição de vídeo (Reels, Shorts, cortes).


O que você vai fazer:
  • Criar e programar postagens;
  • Ajudar a construir a voz da Gamers Brawl nas redes;
  • Transformar stats, batalhas e tretas em conteúdo de qualidade.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
What You’ll Do

As part of our talent acquisition team, you are charged with finding top talent. You’re responsible for guiding candidates through our recruiting process and partnering with hiring leaders to help build their teams. You are enthusiastic and driven, which allows you to develop meaning relationships. You are systems savvy and passionate about improving our recruiting process.


We are looking for a Recruiter with experience identifying top talent for niche positions across different verticals. The ideal candidate demonstrates their expertise by sharing recruiting best practices, engaging highly skilled talent while setting time to fill expectations based on data. He/she is organized, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is a strong communicator.


Please submit your resume in English. Applications in other languages cannot be considered.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Partner with Hiring Leaders to develop a complete understanding of each opening.
  • Manage the entire recruiting life cycle from candidate generation through direct sourcing, interviewing, salary negotiations, job file maintenance, offer extension and closing candidates.
  • Identify passive candidates using intricate Boolean searches, user groups, professional and social networking, candidate referrals, networking, and our ATS
  • Be passionate about social media and savvy internet research
  • Pipeline candidates and identify what future opportunities they may be a fit for
  • Focus & lead on Diversity identification, sourcing, and attraction
  • Proactively research and generate new/creative sourcing ideas for filling challenging positions by using knowledge of current sourcing practices and trends
  • Establish and maintain positive relationships with candidates and hiring leaders throughout the recruiting lifecycle


What You'll Need to be Successful

  • Approximately 6+ years of proven experience as a technical recruiter, with a strong track record of sourcing and closing talent in engineering and product roles.
  • In-house recruiting experience, ideally within tech/SaaS environments
  • Proven track record managing full-cycle recruitment: kick-off calls, job postings, sourcing, screening, assessments, interview coordination, and offer management
  • Excellent written and spoken English

title: Senior C++ Engineer
description:
Dive deep into Digital! For 20 years Intellias has been developing top-tier digital solutions for the world’s leading companies, keeping them in line with the latest technology trends. Join in and provide innovations for the future!


We are looking for a highly motivated and talented Senior Engineer with excellent qualifications to help design and build cross platform libraries and tools to communicate directly with Client machines. The position demands a candidate capable of doing high-quality work against technical and schedule challenges, while following strong

software design and process principles. You will work in a fast-paced environment, delivering world-class products that delight our customers and help the business grow. You live for the best customer experience and are passionate about building great software. You are a driver of change, and you have yet to meet a technological challenge you cannot resolve.


Qualifications for Senior role:

  • Proficient in C, C++
  • Experience in writing Unit and Integration tests
  • Expertise in USB and Bluetooth (Classic and BLE)
  • Experience with development of communications protocols
  • Experience in developing Android, iOS, Windows and macOS libraries/frameworks
  • Experience with CMake – ability to read, understand, and help contribute to current build procedures for
  • cross platform maintainability
  • Experience with package managers (npm, CocoaPods, Maven, NuGet, SwiftPM, etc.)
  • Experience in unit and integration testing
  • Experience with Git in a collaborative environment (pull requests, branching strategies, tags, etc.)
  • Experience in continuous integration and delivery (e.g. GitHub Action)
  • Strong knowledge of and experience with SDLC and Scrum/Agile methodologies
  • A solid grasp of fundamental algorithms, data structures, and design patterns
  • High critical thinking skills to evaluate alternatives and present solutions that are consistent with business
  • objectives and strategy
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbal, with technical and non-technical multifunctional teams
  • Aptitude and desire to independently learn new technologies
  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering or comparable field with 5+ years relevant experience


Preferred:

• Android/iOS experience

• Experience with Swift

• Experience with Kotlin, Java

• Package Management experience.

• CMake experience


Work collaboratively with fellow department members, product managers, firmware engineers, test engineers, and designers to develop cross platform (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows) libraries and tools which interface directly with Client machines through USB and Bluetooth interfaces (BLE and Classic)

  • Developing new features, enhancing existing features and improving the quality of the libraries and tools
  • Apply software engineering design patterns to develop well-structured, modular, performant application code
  • Perform code reviews, write unit and integration tests, and contribute to architectural planning and refactoring
  • Ensure best coding practices
  • Training, mentorship, and development of junior team members


This opportunity is to work remote from Brazil with a B2B contract and payment in USD.


Let us know if you are the one!

title: Atlassian Consultant
description:
Company Description

At Atlas Bench, we are committed to transforming teamwork across industries through innovative Atlassian services. Our global team, proficient in DevOps and ITSM, specializes in agile methodologies and AI solutions tailored for Atlassian products. Serving over 1000 clients, including Fortune 500 companies, we are known for managed licensing, consulting, and AI-driven Atlassian integrations. Our diverse team brings cutting-edge solutions to every project, trusted by leading global firms and reflected in our client success stories.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for an Atlassian Consultant. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Atlassian products such as Jira and Confluence, providing training to clients, and ensuring the smooth integration of Atlassian tools into their workflow. You will also consult on best practices, develop custom solutions to meet client needs, and provide ongoing support and maintenance.

Qualifications
  • Experience with configuring and implementing Atlassian products like Jira, Confluence, and JSM
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps practices and ITSM methodologies
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies and AI solutions for Atlassian tools
  • Skills in providing training and support for Atlassian tools
  • Excellent communication and consulting skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Fortune 500 clients or large-scale enterprise projects is a plus

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS Pleno - 122371
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados Pleno


Requisitos:

Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.). Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados. Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.

Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).

Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados). Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).

Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;

title: IDP Consultant
description:
Practia is present in 7 countries, leading automation and digital transformation projects for major clients. We are one of the most prestigious business and technology companies in Latin America, with a specialized methodology and technical team in automation and Hyperautomation.


We are looking for an IDP Consultant to join our team and deliver end-to-end IDP solutions. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to analyze document requirements, design extraction strategies, configure IDP platforms, and orchestrate document workflows, including human-in-the-loop validation.


What You’ll Do

· Analyze documents and business requirements to define extraction feasibility and development effort.

· Design and architect IDP solutions, including document classification, labeling strategies, extraction rules, NLP/ML models, and workflow design.

· Build and manage workflows including validation and human-in-the-loop activities.

· Conduct testing, performance evaluation, and quality assurance of extraction models.

· Fine-tune classifiers, rules, and ML models to improve accuracy and meet KPIs.

· Collaborate with stakeholders and deliver documentation, training, and knowledge transfer.


What We’re Looking For

· Hands-on experience delivering IDP projects end-to-end.

· Strong knowledge of document extraction techniques, like extraction rules, NLP, deep learning etc.

· Experience with IDP solutions design, architecture, and workflow definition.

· Familiarity with IDP tools such as UiPath Document Understanding, Kofax/ Tungsten, Amazon Textract, Google Document AI, Microsoft AI Builder / Document Intelligence.

· Experience with ABBYY Vantage/FlexiCapture is highly desirable.

· Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g. JavaScript, Python) for customization and integration.

· Strong communication skills with proficiency in English (written and spoken).

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

· Fine-tune classifiers, rules, and ML models to improve accuracy and meet KPIs.

· Collaborate with stakeholders and deliver documentation, training, and knowledge transfer.

· Hands-on experience delivering IDP projects end-to-end.

· Strong knowledge of document extraction techniques, like extraction rules, NLP, deep learning etc.

· Experience with IDP solutions design, architecture, and workflow definition.

· Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g. JavaScript, Python) for customization and integration.

· Strong communication skills with proficiency in English (written and spoken).

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

title: Consultor(a) AWS SR
description:
Profissional com sólida experiência em projetos de dados utilizando o ecossistema AWS, com capacidade de desenhar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e eficientes , desde a ingestão até a disponibilização das informações.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • AWS Glue – Criação e manutenção de jobs, crawlers, catálogos de dados, e integração com outros serviços AWS.
  • Apache Airflow – Orquestração de workflows ETL/ELT, agendamento e monitoramento de pipelines.
  • Python – Desenvolvimento de scripts e automações para tratamento e transformação de dados.
  • PySpark – Processamento distribuído de grandes volumes de dados, otimização de jobs e tuning de performance.
  • Amazon Athena – Criação e otimização de consultas SQL serverless, integração com S3 e Glue Data Catalog.
  • Amazon S3 – Modelagem de buckets, organização de dados brutos e tratados, versionamento e políticas de acesso.
  • AWS Lambda – Funções serverless para processamento em tempo real, automações e integrações.
  • Amazon EMR – Administração e execução de clusters Hadoop/Spark, configuração de ambientes e pipelines de alto desempenho.
  • Git e CI/CD – Versionamento de código, integração e entrega contínua, configuração de pipelines de deploy (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline ou similares).


Habilidades Complementares:

  • Modelagem de dados – Entendimento de estruturas dimensionais, relacionais e não relacionais, normalização/desnormalização e boas práticas para ambientes analíticos.
  • ETL/ELT – Levantamento de requisitos, desenho e implementação de fluxos de extração, transformação e carga, com foco em qualidade e governança.
  • Boas práticas de segurança e compliance no ecossistema AWS (IAM, KMS, políticas de acesso, criptografia).
  • Integração de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos, streams).
  • Monitoramento e observabilidade de pipelines (CloudWatch, logs, métricas e alertas).
  • Documentação técnica clara e manutenção de repositórios de conhecimento.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento básico/intermediário de espanhol para interação com times ou clientes hispano-falantes.
  • Experiência com ambientes multi-conta e multi-região na AWS.
  • Familiaridade com infraestrutura como código (CloudFormation, Terraform ou CDK).
  • Experiência em otimização de custos em workloads de dados na nuvem.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota
  • Projeto temporário de 6 meses

· Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou migração para nuvem.

· Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

title: Web Frontend Developer
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend Web – Trabalhador Contingente (CW) para se juntar à nossa equipe inovadora e colaborativa.


Como Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend Web (CW), você trabalhará em projetos de software altamente técnicos que dão suporte a grandes produções cinematográficas. Você é apaixonado(a) por desenvolver tecnologia inovadora e seguir as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. Gosta de resolver problemas e de desenvolver soluções funcionais, robustas, otimizadas e escaláveis em um ambiente de equipe.


Responsabilidades

-Contribuir com todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de software, incluindo arquitetura, design, estimativa, desenvolvimento, testes e lançamento.

-Colaborar com Product Owners, arquitetos de software e outros engenheiros para transformar requisitos de alto nível em melhorias incrementais no produto.

-Garantir que o novo código esteja em conformidade com os padrões e atenda às especificações das funcionalidades.

-Melhorar as práticas de engenharia dentro da disciplina de desenvolvimento web por meio de revisões de código entre pares.

-Escrever e manter testes automatizados para garantir que o software seja estável e confiável.


Qualificações mínimas

-Mais de 5 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento frontend (Angular e TypeScript).

-Compreensão profunda e aplicação de princípios e padrões de design de software.

-Comprovada habilidade em melhorar a qualidade do código por meio de testes (unitários, de componentes e funcionais) e revisões de código.

-Proficiência na implementação de sistemas de design e no desenvolvimento de bibliotecas de componentes.

-Experiência em projetar e trabalhar com APIs.

-Coragem para se expressar ativamente, colaborar e contribuir com ideias em um ambiente de equipe global.


☑️Qualificações desejadas

-Proficiência em Angular, RxJS e NgRx.

-Experiência em trabalhar com equipes distribuídas e multifuncionais.

-Histórico de desenvolvimento de aplicações SaaS de alto perfil.

Gosta de resolver problemas e de desenvolver soluções funcionais, robustas, otimizadas e escaláveis em um ambiente de equipe.


Responsabilidades

-Contribuir com todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de software, incluindo arquitetura, design, estimativa, desenvolvimento, testes e lançamento.

-Colaborar com Product Owners, arquitetos de software e outros engenheiros para transformar requisitos de alto nível em melhorias incrementais no produto.

-Garantir que o novo código esteja em conformidade com os padrões e atenda às especificações das funcionalidades.

-Melhorar as práticas de engenharia dentro da disciplina de desenvolvimento web por meio de revisões de código entre pares.

-Escrever e manter testes automatizados para garantir que o software seja estável e confiável.


Qualificações mínimas

-Mais de 5 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento frontend (Angular e TypeScript).

-Compreensão profunda e aplicação de princípios e padrões de design de software.

-Comprovada habilidade em melhorar a qualidade do código por meio de testes (unitários, de componentes e funcionais) e revisões de código.

-Proficiência na implementação de sistemas de design e no desenvolvimento de bibliotecas de componentes.

-Experiência em projetar e trabalhar com APIs.

-Coragem para se expressar ativamente, colaborar e contribuir com ideias em um ambiente de equipe global.


☑️Qualificações desejadas

-Proficiência em Angular, RxJS e NgRx.

-Experiência em trabalhar com equipes distribuídas e multifuncionais.

-Histórico de desenvolvimento de aplicações SaaS de alto perfil.

title: Senior Counsel
description:
Our Senior Counsel will be responsible for leading client correspondence and managing client relationships. We value organized, collegial and highly motivated individuals with a client-centered approach to legal representation. This position is ideal for an entrepreneurial attorney who possesses strong leadership and communication skills and who thrives in a dynamic environment. The Senior Counsel will help shape our legal services, counseling our clients with clear and concise contract drafting, communicating with clients’ internal and external stakeholders, leading complex commercial negotiations, and providing counsel on general risk management. This role is for someone who is committed to offering best-in-class legal services and has a desire to be a proactive strategic partner.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the negotiation of SaaS agreements for clients negotiating with Fortune 500 customers, and identify, coordinate and resolve issues for subject matter expert review
  • Support clients’ business units with structuring and negotiating a variety of transactions relating to product commercialization and corporate development, including early-stage investments, joint ventures, and mergers and acquisitions
  • Provide general counsel and partner with third party subject matter experts to efficiently lead a comprehensive legal strategy
  • Assist with corporate governance processes including managing internal corporate actions, charters, bylaws, and board meeting materials
  • Collaborate with the Managing Counsel on business development activities to drive firm growth
  • Operate with limited supervision, demonstrate sound judgment and an ability to independently and effectively manage priorities, and proactively identify when to escalate issues with internal and client stakeholders


Qualifications

  • JD from a top tier law school and excellent academic credentials
  • Admission to the state bar where the candidate resides
  • 6+ years of experience at a law firm (AmLaw 100 preferred), in-house, or preferably both
  • Ability to deliver polished work product and effectively collaborate with clients and negotiate with third parties
  • Strong drafting skills and the ability to identify, incorporate and improve client-preferred terms
  • Commitment to integrity, excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to lead with empathy
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple matters simultaneously
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and high attention to detail


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health/Sport Budget
  • Fully remote

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Engenheiro de dados Gestão de estruturas de dados, definição de modelos e padrões logidos de dados como unica fonte de informação (data lake com governança de dados ); Experiencia em arquitetura de Dados; Desenvolvimento Python; Experiencia em coleta, transformação e carga de dados (ferramentas de ETL ); Experiência em trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados; Modelagem de Banco de Dados (SQL, Hadoop, MySQL, Redshift, ); Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB ); Integração de dados com outros sistemas Plataforma AWS; Experiência em workloads de missão crítica; Containers (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, EKS Openshift); DevOps (Gitlab; Gitlab CI, Puppet); Cloudformation (Code Build, CodePipeline) Softwares Necessários: API Gateway . Kafka . AWS Lake Formation . AWS Banco de Dados (Redshift, MySQL, Dynam DB,..) . AWS Athena . AWS GLUE ( Crawlers, Jobs, workflow) . AWS Quick Sigth . AWS EMR . AWS Lambda.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;

  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: User Experience Designer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Senior UX/UI Designer
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract



Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the full UX/UI design process, from research and discovery to prototyping and final delivery.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, heuristic evaluations, and competitive analysis to uncover user insights and pain points.
  • Translate research findings into personas, user flows, journey maps, and wireframes that guide product direction.
  • Develop high-fidelity UI designs and maintain design systems that ensure cross-platform consistency.
  • Define and advocate for UX best practices, accessibility standards, and inclusive design principles.
  • Independently identify design opportunities, propose solutions, and make strategic design decisions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure feasibility, usability, and design consistency.
  • Present design rationale and research-backed recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.


Must-Have Requirements

  • 7+ years of UX/UI design experience, with a strong portfolio showcasing research-driven design decisions.
  • Proven ability to independently lead design initiatives from concept to execution.
  • Expertise in user research methods (interviews, surveys, usability studies, A/B testing).
  • Strong proficiency with modern design tools (Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, InVision, Miro, etc.).
  • Experience creating and maintaining design systems and component libraries.
  • Solid knowledge of information architecture, interaction design, and visual design principles.
  • Ability to simplify complex problems into elegant, user-friendly solutions.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence non-design stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript basics).
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practices.

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Software - Backend
description:
Remoto | Grupo SBF | Ecossistema do Esporte


Estamos procurando uma pessoa Especialista em Engenharia de Software Backend para atuar com impacto técnico transversal em nossos produtos e sistemas. Essa é uma posição estratégica, com grande poder de influência técnica, sem papel formal de gestão.

Se você é apaixonado por engenharia de software, adora resolver problemas complexos com elegância e tem perfil de liderança técnica, essa vaga é pra você!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Sólida experiência como engenheiro(a) backend atuando com sistemas distribuídos e de larga escala;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software com Golang ou JavaScript ;
  • Experiência com Kafka, arquitetura orientada a eventos, microsserviços e APIs robustas ;
  • Conhecimento prático em Docker, Kubernetes e cloud (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Domínio de CI/CD, testes automatizados, observabilidade e boas práticas modernas de engenharia;
  • Forte base em arquitetura evolutiva, DDD, SOLID, clean code ;
  • Excelente comunicação técnica e empática .


✨ Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Experiência com GCP e práticas avançadas de CI/CD;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou publicações;
  • Ter puxado iniciativas de melhoria contínua com impacto entre vários times.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

  • Liderar projetos de implementação e migração SAP S/4HANA em diferentes países da América Latina.

  • Certificação SAP Activate (obrigatória).

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)


About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).


Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.


The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.


What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.


MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.


Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF/HTML/images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design (HIPAA/PII ), APIs/webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/HubSpot /Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data/model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, rollback.


Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.


Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM/Marketing (HubSpot/Salesforce) , VoIP/SMS, CMS, accounting/payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA/PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.


EEO

AMX Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Agriculture Specialist
description:
We are looking for Image Annotation Analyst having background in Agriculture from Brazil. If you are interested and reside in Brazil, kindly apply to the post on urgent basis as we are anticipating the project to get started this week.


Please find the details below: -

  • Project Name: Image Annotation Analyst- Agriculture
  • Hourly Rate: $16 per hour
  • Required Hours: 5-6 hours per day (flexible hours)
  • Project Start Date: This week
  • Location: Brazil
  • Language: local
  • Required Education: Agriculture or agriculture related streams like horticulture , food science etc.


We are looking for an Annotation Analyst to join the team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for annotating agriculture dataset, identifying crop type and stages, ensuring the quality, consistency, and accuracy of datasets. Raters are required to interpretate crop types, annotation, and identifying the stages.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s/master’s degree in agriculture
  • Experience in agricultural field studies and data annotation.
  • Knowledge of crop classification, phenology (growth stages), and field boundary identification.
  • Prior work with street view imagery of agricultural datasets.

title: Electrical BIM Specialist
description:
Now Hiring: Electrical BIM Specialist

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Engagement Type: Full-Time

Work Format: Work From Home


Note: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume in English.


At Eracore , we bring innovation and precision to the forefront of electrical construction through advanced BIM modeling. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Backed by a dynamic team of 40+ talented modelers and engineers, Eracore is more than just a workplace its a launchpad for ambitious professionals. We collaborate with top-tier electrical contractors nationwide, offering unparalleled exposure, hands-on experience, and real opportunities for career advancement.


If you're ready to work on game-changing projects, grow alongside a fast-rising company, and be part of shaping the future of electrical construction, Eracore is where your next chapter begins.


Join us and shape the future of the construction industry!


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a BIM/VDC Specialist at Eracore . The Electrical BIM Modeler will be responsible for creating 3D models and shop drawings to provide clarity and precision during field installations. The role involves utilizing BIM software for visualization and validation of electrical installations.


Qualifications

  • 3-4 Years of Experience with Revit
  • Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Construction Drawings skills
  • Experience with Prefabrication Spool Drawings
  • Experience in working with Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) systems
  • Proficiency in Architecture and Modeler software
  • Knowledge of electrical design principles and calculations
  • Ability to interpret and create single line diagrams
  • Experience in load calculations and voltage drop evaluations
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 17-23k real/mo.


MUST HAVE

3-4 years Back End and 4 years Front End Front end is React

They have to have experience working in Back End and WANT to work in GO

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Experience software development using JavaScript ES6, HTML5, and CSS3.

Experience with React or React Native, particularly with functional components and hooks.

Experience with statically typed languages such as Go, C, C++, or Rust.

Solid understanding of server-side rendering (SSR), asynchronous request handling, partial page updates, and RESTful APIs.

Proficiency in Redux, TypeScript, and NoSQL databases.

Commitment to high-quality coding practices, including comprehensive documentation, active participation in code reviews, and adherence to best practices in software development.

Passion for staying current with the latest software tools and methodologies.

Intellectual curiosity and strong problem-solving skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


PLUS:

Golang experience


D2D:

This specific project is focusing on the enhancements and new features of the Total Wine Website. This specific team works on rewards system and preference center (account information, opt in, etc.)

They have some work planned out in integrating promotion engineering

Doing maintenance work with core team. Updating versions of Node, Go and secruoty vulnerability work. Might pick up backlog of cart and checkout team as well

collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, backend engineers, test automation engineers, UX designers, and Scrum Masters to continuously enhance customer experience.

Develop and maintain modular frontend web and mobile applications, ensuring high performance, maintainability, and testability.

Participate in the development and updating of shared component libraries to enable rapid iteration and consistent development practices.

Mentor and coach mid-level and junior developers, fostering a sense of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.

Cultivate a positive team atmosphere that encourages open communication, creative problem-solving, and innovative thinking.

Translate functional requirements into responsive components and pages with a mobile-first mentality, championing accessibility best practices.

Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues, ensuring the stability and reliability of applications.

Contribute to code reviews and automated testing efforts, ensuring code quality and meeting coverage targets.

Participate in an on-call rotation with the entire digital and engineering organizations, including Directors and members of the Product team.
