title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.


WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency


BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands


WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.


With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Pl
description:
Desde 2014 na pista, acelerando no segmento de tecnologia com foco em inovação automotiva, somos especialistas no setor e temos como combustível a paixão pela cultura do automóvel. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor e mais segura experiência, tanto para o motorista que busca soluções rápidas após um imprevisto no carro, quanto para as oficinas que encontram na nossa plataforma uma rota certeira para conquistar novos clientes. Nossos pilotos são movidos a inovação e adrenalina. Aqui, ninguém freia diante do comum, e com nosso motor turbo, seguimos todos na mesma pista, acelerando rumo a resultados extraordinários. Estamos aqui para transformar, evoluir e deixar nossa marca na estrada. Acha que criatividade, inovação e mobilidade podem nos levar mais longe? Então, venha fazer parte da nossa viagem – aqui, o único combustível ruim é o da concorrência!



Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando tecnologias .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API).
  • Criar e integrar interfaces responsivas com frameworks modernos como Angular, React ou Vue.js.
  • Participar da análise, arquitetura e design de soluções técnicas escaláveis e seguras.
  • Realizar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados) para garantir a qualidade do código.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (UX/UI, QA, Produto) para entrega de soluções completas.
  • Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados, promovendo refatorações quando necessário.
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento de código (Git), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento.
  • Documentar funcionalidades, APIs e decisões técnicas de forma clara e acessível.



Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento em .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) .
  • Conhecimento sólido em JavaScript , HTML5 , CSS3 e frameworks modernos como Angular , React ou Vue.js .
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful , integração de serviços e consumo de dados.
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Prática com versionamento utilizando Git .
  • Experiência com Entity Framework Core ou outras ferramentas ORM.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de testes automatizados (unitários, integrados).
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Capacidade de escrever código limpo, reutilizável e bem documentado.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Será um diferencial:


  • Experiência com Azure , AWS ou outro provedor de cloud computing.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (ex: ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços .
  • Conhecimento em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID.
  • Experiência com CI/CD pipelines utilizando ferramentas como Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI.
  • Certificações Microsoft ou outras relacionadas à área de desenvolvimento.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller – Gold Mining Sector – Brazil

An international mining company developing a promising gold project in northern Brazil (Pará region) is seeking a Financial Controller to play a key role in managing the financial, accounting, and administrative functions of its Brazilian operations. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing organization and contribute to the development of a strategic asset in the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee the activities of the external accounting firm , ensuring compliance with local regulations and corporate policies;
  • Lead the budgeting and forecasting process, including financial planning, cost control, and variance analysis;
  • Manage current and future contracts , ensuring alignment with company policies and efficient resource allocation;
  • Maintain control of fixed assets , including registration, depreciation, and reconciliation;
  • Supervise procurement, accounts payable, and accounts receivable processes;
  • Prepare and deliver financial and management reports to corporate headquarters, providing insightful analysis and recommendations;
  • Strengthen internal controls and improve administrative and financial procedures;
  • Lead and develop the local team , promoting best practices in governance and operational efficiency;
  • Work remotely , with frequent visits to the project site in northern Brazil (Pará region) .

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field ;
  • Proven experience in controllership and corporate finance , ideally within the mining, energy, or infrastructure sectors ;
  • Strong background managing third-party accounting services and financial compliance;
  • Solid understanding of budgeting, forecasting, contracts, and internal controls ;
  • Analytical, proactive, and results-oriented profile with the ability to work independently;
  • Fluent Portuguese
  • Advanced English proficiency is highly desirable.

Location

This is a remote position , with regular travel to the company’s operations in northern Brazil (Pará region) .

title: Tech Lead
description:
A Plus IT está em busca de um Tech Lead Java para liderar iniciativas de alta complexidade em um banco digital em expansão. Procuramos um profissional com forte experiência técnica e capacidade de liderança, que saiba equilibrar inovação, performance e segurança, especialmente em contextos que envolvem sistemas legados e novas tecnologias .


Liderar equipes técnicas no desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e seguras, com foco na integração de sistemas legados e adoção de boas práticas de arquitetura moderna , alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos do cliente.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência com Java , domínio sólido de Java 11
  • Experiência avançada com Spring Framework (Boot, Data, Batch)
  • APIs RESTful , banco de dados NoSQL (MongoDB) e relacionais (MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server)
  • Conhecimentos em AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, SQS)
  • Redis para cache e otimização de performance
  • Testes automatizados com JUnit
  • Práticas de Clean Code e princípios SOLID
  • Maven , Docker , Jenkins , JFrog
  • Experiência com sistemas legados e refatoração


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Java 17
  • Mensageria com AWS SQS
  • Prática com arquitetura em AWS avançada
  • Profundo conhecimento em Oracle, SQL Server , soluções híbridas


Informações adicionais:

  • 100% Remoto | Banco Digital | Projeto Estratégico

title: Business Developer for Social Media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.


This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.


As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify high-revenue potential YouTube, Facebook, and Snapchat channels aligned with the business goals
  • Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
  • Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
  • Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
  • Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic priorities


Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
  • Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
  • Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
  • Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainment


If you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!


Please upload your updated CV in English!

As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.

  • Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
  • Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes

  • Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic priorities

  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
  • Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills

title: Cornerstone Certified Consultant
description:
Job Title: Cornerstone Certified Consultant Location: Remote – ( US Working hours )  Contract Type: Long-term Contract ( 2 years ) Rate:  Negotiable ( Hourly ) About the Project We are supporting a large-scale global migration program for a leading enterprise software provider. The initiative involves transitioning several hundred North American clients from legacy learning systems to the Cornerstone OnDemand platform.
This is a long-term engagement with strong potential for continuation and expansion into other regions (Europe and Asia). We are seeking Cornerstone-certified consultants with proven implementation experience to join the delivery team.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and support Cornerstone OnDemand implementations, primarily focusing on Learning and Core modules.
  • Collaborate with internal and client teams to deliver end-to-end configurations, integrations, and testing.
  • Manage functional design documentation, system setup, and knowledge transfer.
  • Troubleshoot issues and ensure high-quality delivery aligned with platform standards.
  • Work remotely but aligned to US time zones due to client location.
Required Qualifications
  • Partner-certified in Cornerstone OnDemand, with active certifications in:
  • Core
  • Learning
  • Implementation Workshop
    (Note: Client-side certifications cannot be accepted.)
  • 10+ Cornerstone implementations completed (Learning module experience essential).
  • Strong understanding of Cornerstone’s configuration, workflows, and data management.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken).
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed, multicultural team.
    Nice to Have
    • Experience across additional Cornerstone modules (Performance, Succession, Recruiting, etc.).
    • Prior work with large enterprise clients or global HR transformation projects.
    • Experience migrating from legacy LMS platforms (e.g., Saba, SumTotal).
    Certification & Validation All applicants must be able to verify their Cornerstone Partner Certification (active or within the reactivation window).
    Candidates will be required to complete a certification validation process prior to client submission.

title: Desenvolvedor D365 F&O (Azure Logic Apps)
description:
Você é apaixonado por construir soluções em nuvem que impulsionam a transformação empresarial? Junte-se à nossa equipe como Desenvolvedor D365 F&O, onde você irá projetar, desenvolver e manter fluxos de trabalho com Azure Logic Apps que viabilizam integrações, migrações de dados e soluções personalizadas para o Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.


Responsabilidades:


• Criar e implantar Azure Logic Apps para automatizar fluxos de trabalho e integrar sistemas.

• Liderar processos ETL para limpeza, mapeamento e migração de dados para o D365 F&O.

• Desenvolver soluções personalizadas em X++ utilizando pipelines do Azure DevOps.

• Criar APIs, conectores e scripts para integração fluida entre aplicativos.

• Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções de alto impacto.

• Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas com Azure Logic Apps.

• Garantir segurança, conformidade e manter documentação detalhada.



Experiência:


• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em automação de fluxos de trabalho em nuvem e integrações de sistemas.

• Forte domínio de Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions e serviços relacionados.

• Compreensão sólida da estrutura de banco de dados do D365 F&O e desenvolvimento em X++.

• Experiência com SQL, SSIS, APIs RESTful e serviços SOAP.

• Habilidade com Azure DevOps, testes/debugging e otimização de desempenho.

• Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas, gestão de tempo e comunicação.

• Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente.

title: Dynamics 365 Expert
description:
We are a forward-thinking corporate group building our IT landscape around Microsoft Business Applications. To strengthen our internal IT team, we are looking for a Dynamics 365 Expert with deep knowledge of Finance & Operations, Human Resources, and Project Operations.



Job Definition

• Manage and continuously improve our Dynamics 365 applications.

• Collaborate with business units to identify requirements and translate them into effective solutions.

• Configure and extend Dynamics 365.

• Ensure system stability, data quality, and efficient business processes.

• Support key users, documentation, and release management activities.



Job Qualification

• Several years of experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, ideally in Finance & Operations, Human Resources, or Project Operations.

• Solid knowledge of the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse).

• Understanding of data structures and business processes.

• Good command of Business English.

• Independent, structured, and quality-focused working style.


Benefits

• We support, offer and cover the cost of language courses from level A1 to C1.

• We love to celebrate together: e.g. yearly company party, Christmas party, team-building events, …

• We support you to help you grow individually by a variety of training programs

• We offer attractive relocation packages to assist you in moving for your new position.

title: Consultor SAP IBP Pleno # 981152'
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento na área da Tecnologia.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Liderar projetos SAP IBP desde o levantamento de requisitos até a entrega da solução.
  • Configurar e implementar módulos do IBP.
  • Preferencial: IBP for Demand (Previsão), IBP for Response (Baseado em Pedidos).
  • Desejável: IBP for Supply, Otimização de Inventário, S&OP.
  • Realizar análise de aderência (Fit/Gap), design funcional, configuração, testes e cutover.
  • Treinar usuários-chave e apoiar a transferência de conhecimento.


O que você precisa ter

  • 4–6 anos de experiência em implementação do SAP IBP (preferencial).
  • Forte conhecimento dos processos do IBP: Planejamento de Suprimentos e Demanda, S&OP, Planejamento de Inventário.
  • Experiência prática em design, configuração e construção do IBP.
  • Mentalidade voltada para resolução de problemas, senso de responsabilidade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação com equipes técnicas.
  • Experiência em Cadeia de Suprimentos/Logística é um diferencial.
  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório).


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
FBS is a global trading and investment platform focused on users.

The mission of FBS is to create the most convenient tool on the market for fast financial transactions, investing, and trading with quick adaptation to the user's preferences and pursuing interests.

Our team consists of more than 450 professionals from 15 countries. As for the company’s geographic coverage, FBS established its main regional presence in South-East Asia, Europe, South America, Africa, and Australia.


You will:


  • Provide prompt and effective assistance in chats and tickets, responding to customer inquiries based on the knowledge base and training materials.
  • Maintain KPI levels in accordance with department standards.
  • Stay informed about company policies, announcements, and updates to ensure effective communication with customers.
  • Adhere to assigned working hours and demonstrate punctuality in scheduled shifts.
  • Identify and report system errors or service disruptions to the team lead or mid/senior agents in the absence of the team lead.
  • Escalate complex customer issues to the team lead or mid/senior agents to ensure proper follow-up and resolution.


It's a match if:


  • You speak English, Spanish and Portuguese fluently.
  • You have excellent communication skills and quick and efficient problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent customer service skills: you are empathetic, accurate, compassionate, responsive, resourceful, and conscientious. You can find an approach to all types of people.
  • You are ready to work 40 hours per week with a shift schedule (flexible hours).


Nice to have:


  • Work experience in customer support.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.


We offer:


  • Expertise development. Work in a team with top-notch professionals in their field. Opportunities for networking, exchange of experience, and internal and external training at the company's expense.
  • You get to affect the result. There’s no bureaucracy or the need for a large number of approvals. The processes within the team are subject to change – you can easily control their development and alignment of global operations.
  • Comfortable conditions. Remote work and friendly atmosphere. Rich corporate life.
  • Stability. Competitive official salary, advanced benefits system (medicine, additional pay on sick leave, etc.).

title: Especialista de Gamificação | CRM iGaming
description:
A RETEM é uma consultoria e BPO de CRM especializada em iGaming. Atuamos como braço estratégico e operacional de casas de apostas e cassinos online na América Latina, com foco nos quatro pilares que movem o setor: ativação, retenção, monetização e recuperação.


Já geramos centenas de milhões de reais em GGR impulsionando campanhas, jornadas e estratégias de relacionamento. Somos obcecados por performance, dados e experiência do jogador — e queremos quem compartilha dessa mesma visão.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Gamificação apaixonado por engajamento, mecânicas motivacionais e comportamento do jogador.


Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e operar mecânicas de gamificação (missões, metas, badges, ranking, loja de pontos).
  • Definir economia de pontos e regras de progressão por segmento.
  • Integrar gamificação às jornadas de onboarding, retenção e VIP.
  • Acompanhar KPIs de engajamento e ajustar loops motivacionais.


Requisitos

  • Experiência com gamificação aplicada a CRM.
  • Experiência com iGaming e análise de comportamento.
  • Capacidade analítica para calibrar incentivos.
  • Integração com Automação e Dados.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência em Smartico.
  • Conhecimento de behavioral design.
  • BI básico para leitura de impacto.
  • Espanhol ou inglês.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $6,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a security-conscious contract Senior level Software Engineer to help enhance the security posture of their applications. The primary focus of this role is to systematically reduce their attack surface by addressing high-priority security risks. Using Snyk as the primary scanning tool, this engineer will be responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and remediating dependencies with known exploitable vulnerabilities. The goal is a targeted reduction of risk, not a simple "update-all" approach.


Role & Responsibilities:

The engineer will be responsible for the following:

  • Vulnerability Analysis:  Analyze the results of Snyk scans of their codebases (Ruby, Go, Python, JavaScript).
  • Prioritization:  Critically assess Snyk reports to distinguish between theoretical vulnerabilities and those that are genuinely exploitable within the context of their applications.
  • Targeted Remediation:  Plan and execute targeted dependency upgrades or apply patches specifically to fix the prioritized exploitable vulnerabilities, ensuring minimal disruption to the system.
  • Code & Test Validation:  Refactor code and update unit/integration tests as necessary to support the upgraded dependencies and validate the fixes.
  • Collaboration & Documentation:  Work closely with internal security and engineering teams, participate in code reviews, and clearly document the rationale for each remediation.


Required Skills & Qualifications (Must-Haves):

Candidates must have demonstrable, hands-on experience in the following areas:

  • Security Tooling:  Proven professional experience using Snyk  to identify, prioritize, and manage vulnerabilities in a production environment. Candidate must be able to interpret Snyk's findings, including exploit maturity and reachability.
  • Strong professional experience with all of the following languages:

- Ruby (including Ruby on Rails)

- Go

- Python

- JavaScript

- TypeScript

  • Deep expertise with package managers for each ecosystem (e.g., package.json, Go Modules, Pip/Poetry, NPM/Yarn).
  • Version Control:  Expert-level proficiency with Git.
  • Automated Testing:  A strong commitment to quality with proven experience in writing comprehensive tests.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves):

While not mandatory, preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

  • Other Security Tools:  Familiarity with other SAST/SCA tools (e.g., GitHub Advanced Security, Checkmarx, Trivy).
  • CI/CD Integration:  Experience integrating security tools like Snyk into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Containerization:  Experience with Docker and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position, allowing for work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to be a part of a mission-driven company that is committed to taking care of its employees.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year
  • 10 paid days for local holidays


Work Schedule : US Eastern Standard Time


*Please note this role is currently for a 3-month project with the potential for a long-term position.

title: Regional Data Visualization & BI Specialist
description:
Esta posición es clave para traducir datos en historias comprensibles a través de dashboards interactivos y efectivos. Como Data Visualization & BI Specialist serás responsable de diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards enfocados en la toma de decisiones para un cliente estratégico de IPG Mediabrands. Colaborarás estrechamente con ingenieros de datos, project managers y equipos de cliente para definir soluciones de visualización que generen impacto. Esta posición reporta directamente al Regional BI Manager y forma parte de una red regional comprometida con elevar el estándar de nuestras capacidades en visualización.




Responsabilidades clave


  • Diseñar y desarrollar dashboards efectivos y atractivos utilizando PowerBI principalmente.
  • Transformar y preparar datos utilizando Power Query desde diversas fuentes como BigQuery, APIs y archivos planos.
  • Desarrollar métricas complejas y cálculos con DAX alineados a los objetivos del cliente.
  • Administrar, actualizar y optimizar dashboards en producción, resolviendo incidentes en colaboración con los equipos técnicos.
  • Colaborar con Data Engineers para definir modelos de datos que respalden las necesidades de visualización.
  • Capacitar a usuarios finales y promover las mejores prácticas de visualización dentro del cliente y del equipo interno.
  • Documentar procesos y soluciones para asegurar escalabilidad y reutilización.
  • Contribuir al desarrollo y evolución de nuestras capacidades de visualización en instancias locales y regionales.


Cualificaciones Esenciales


  • +5 años de experiencia comprobable diseñando dashboards en PowerBI, con un portafolio sólido que demuestre excelencia visual y analítica.
  • Dominio de Power Query para tareas de transformación de datos.
  • Sólidos conocimientos en DAX para la creación de KPIs y lógica analítica.
  • Conocimientos en modelado de datos y principios de UX/UI aplicados a visualización.
  • Manejo de BigQuery y lenguaje SQL.
  • Habilidad para comunicar resultados a públicos técnicos y no técnicos.
  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos ágiles.



Habilidades y características deseadas


  • Experiencia previa en la industria de medios o publicidad, especialmente en canales digitales como redes sociales o publicidad programática. (NO EXCLUYENTE)
  • Conocimiento en administración de espacios de trabajo en PowerBI y optimización de rendimiento.
  • Pasión por la innovación, iniciativa para aprender nuevas tecnologías de BI y compartir conocimientos con el equipo.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations

title: Quality Assurance Lead Automotive
description:
Are you fascinated by e-mobility, infotainment, telematics, and cutting-edge automotive technologies? Would you like to contribute to these areas as a Quality Assurance Lead Automotive and take on a key role in driving innovative solutions forward? If so, we’d love to hear from you!

To strengthen our consulting team for a premium car manufacturer, we are looking for a skilled Quality Assurance Lead Automotive to join our international team. In this role, you will lead and coordinate quality efforts, applying innovative approaches and technologies to ensure KPIs are achieved, while effectively communicating results to key stakeholders in the automotive sector.

If you are passionate about software and system testing, experienced in managing test strategies and teams, and eager to contribute to cutting-edge solutions as part of a diverse, collaborative team spread across multiple global locations, this opportunity is for you!

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead independent technical analysis, documentation and elimination of reported issues.
  • End-to-end support with troubleshooting issues and communicating resolutions to the specific departments.
  • Responsible for organization and coordination of test campaigns.
  • Ensure the quality of the tickets raised, act and escalate in case of problems.
  • Proper documentation of errors and implemented solutions in the database.
  • Manage the Problem Management System.
  • Measure KPIs and create reports.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
  • High interest in digital features, systems and connectivity in the automotive sector.
  • Desirable: knowledge in automotive electronics and bus systems (CAN, Ethernet, LIN…) and agile methodologies and tools (Confluence, Jira).
  • Proficient in IT tools.
  • ITIL knowledge is beneficial.
  • Fluent English. German is a plus.

BENEFITS

  • Individual guidance and mentoring from the start, personal development to improve your professional growth.
  • Working with the latest technology and state-of-the-art equipment.
  • Short- and long-term international opportunities.
  • We support your health with attractive offers like gym subsidies, health workshops, sport events...
  • We support, offer and cover the cost of language courses from level A1 to C1.

Apply now!

Pixida is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer! We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires and respects all individuals and in which all aspects of employment are applied without discrimination. Therefore, we encourage all individuals to apply! Please provide your CV (already with certificates, employer's references, etc.) In addition, we ask you to provide information about your possible start date, salary expectations and language skills.

title: [Remote] Senior Software Engineer (Java)
description:
Location: Remote (New Zealand time zone overlap preferred)

Type: Contractor / Full-Time

Hours: Flexible, with at least 3–4 hours of overlap with NZT (18h-22h BRT)

Start Date: Immediate


About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience in Java and strong working knowledge of Node.js and Python . This role goes beyond traditional development—you’ll be expected to embrace AI as part of your daily toolkit , using it to improve efficiency, generate insights, and accelerate delivery.


You’ll work across a variety of projects, including green-field builds where you’ll own architecture and design decisions, collaborating directly with clients to shape solutions from concept through delivery.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and deliver scalable, secure, and performant solutions in green-field and ongoing projects.
  • Build applications in Java, Node.js and Python .
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, AI debugging tools, etc) to speed up development, improve documentation, and optimise workflows.
  • Collaborate directly with clients to gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and deliver value.
  • Define engineering best practices, technical roadmaps, and solution design standards.
  • Mentor engineers and foster a culture of experimentation, quality, and continuous learning.


Requirements

  • 10+ years of professional experience in software engineering with strong Java expertise.
  • Working knowledge of Node.js and Python .
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering green-field projects.
  • Strong grasp of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Comfortable and proactive in using AI tools for coding, documentation, testing, and prototyping .
  • Excellent communication skills in English, written and spoken.
  • Ability to work directly with clients in a consultative and collaborative manner.


Desirable

  • Experience in high-autonomy/startup environments.
  • Familiarity with microservices, Docker/Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Exposure to AI/ML project work (bonus but not required).


What we offer

description:
Net Developer

Location _ Remote



Data Analysis and Wealth Management

Location: Mexico (Remote)


Job Description:


As an individual contributor of our technology group, this role is expected to work with the product management team to understand the requirements and manage the end-to-end development cycle from design to implementation.

If you are passionate about solving problems and hungry to learn new technologies, we would like to talk to you!


Key Responsibilities:


  • Utilizes established development tools, guidelines and conventions including but not limited to .NET Core, ASP.NET, MVC, C#, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and MS SQL.
  • Must have Azure experience
  • Designs, codes, tests, and documents Windows Applications, Web Applications, and Web Services.
  • Defines and enhances SOA frameworks and supporting technical documents.
  • Experience in MS SQL.
  • Possesses mature critical thinking skills, self-direction, and expert level troubleshooting abilities.
  • Enhances existing systems by analyzing business objectives, preparing action plans. and identifying areas for modification and improvement.
  • Maintains existing software systems by identifying and correcting software defects.
  • Investigates and develops skills in new technologies and software tools.
  • Creates technical specifications.
  • Creates new and extend existing operational documentation.
  • Participates in peer reviews and walkthroughs.
  • Plans and implements every process step as defined in methodologies.
  • This position will perform other duties as assigned based on the needs of the department.


Core Competencies:

  • Strong communicator with the ability to be clear, articulate, effective, and able to interact and be understood by all levels and various teams across the company.
  • Possess sound critical thinking skills, self-direction, and expert level troubleshooting abilities. Ability to perform daily tasks while also striving to improve process and technology.
  • A passion for solving problems.
  • Organized and dependable, with the ability to manage multiple projects and changing business priorities.
  • Expert knowledge of .NET Core, ASP.NET, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and C#.
  • Detailed oriented, quick learner, self-starter.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple concurrent assignments.

Required Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Information Systems, or equivalent field
  • Strong experience with software design/development, with a majority of time focused on building large scale online applications on Microsoft Technologies
  • Extensive experience in relational database design and development with MS SQL Server
  • Experience building WCF Services, Entity Framework or other Service frameworks.
  • Experience building ASP.Net MVC or Web Forms based Web applications, Entity Framework or other Service frameworks
  • Experience building Microservices on Azure or AWS using Docker or other Containerization technologies

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: Senior Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Staff Accountant (Netsuite)
description:
SUMMARY


INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. This role plays a key part in supporting Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on experience with NetSuite, and enjoys working in a structured, process-driven environment. This position is responsible for data entry, testing, reconciliations, and configuration validation within the NetSuite system.


PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES


NetSuite Accounting Data Management


  • Enter and validate accounting-related data in NetSuite.
  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of all accounting entries in NetSuite across AR, AP, GL, and Payroll modules.
  • Conduct regular audits to identify and correct data inconsistencies or configuration issues.
  • Support daily transactional entry, adjustments, and posting of journal entries under supervision.


Testing & System Validation


  • Assist in testing accounting processes across NetSuite modules:
  • Validate system workflows for AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, and Payroll.
  • Perform UAT (User Acceptance Testing) during NetSuite updates or enhancements.
  • Work closely with the Accounting, Finance, and IT teams to identify and troubleshoot accounting-related system errors or configuration gaps.
  • Help document testing procedures and results for audit and compliance purposes.


Month-End & Operational Support


  • Support the month-end close process by preparing, verifying, and entering journal entries in NetSuite.
  • Assist in reconciling general ledger accounts and running reports to support financial review.
  • Ensure system data is closed and locked appropriately in accordance with internal deadlines.


Documentation & Internal Support


  • Maintain accurate documentation of system processes, data input standards, and workflows within NetSuite.
  • Assist accounting team members in navigating NetSuite functionality and resolving data entry issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of NetSuite accounting procedures and controls.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


KEY COMPETENCIES


  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite ERP and accounting module navigation.
  • Understanding of US GAAP accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative accounting team.
  • Capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting data manipulation.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of accounting experience, with 2+ years of hands-on strong experience in NetSuite ERP.
  • Solid understanding of general accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
  • Experience working with accounting data across modules like AR, AP, GL, and Payroll.


WHAT WE OFFER


  • Remote work opportunity.
  • Working hours 8-5 EST (preferred).
  • Monthly gross salary within the range of $1000-$2200.
  • Participating in our "One Window - One Tree" initiative.
  • The opportunity to improve your skills through professional development training.
  • A rapidly growing company.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: Chatbot Developer Pleno
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Responsável por desenvolver e manter chatbots em diferentes plataformas, com foco em JavaScript e Python.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Manutenção Multi-Plataforma: Atuar na sustentação, troubleshooting e correção de bugs de chatbots desenvolvidos e implantados nas plataformas BLiP e Rasa.
  • Evolução Rasa: Manter e evoluir a estrutura do framework Rasa, incluindo as custom actions, o deploy e, principalmente, os pipelines de NLU e as stories complexas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura Rasa: Gerenciar e manter o ambiente de deploy do bot em Rasa, garantindo o bom funcionamento e a estabilidade.
  • Integrações: Utilizar integrações de back-end (APIs, Webhooks) para o funcionamento dos fluxos em ambas as plataformas.
  • Qualidade Conversacional e Métricas: Trabalhar com a curadoria, refinando modelos de NLP/NLU. Além disso, definir e monitorar métricas de performance conversacional (ex: Intent Accuracy, Fallback Rate, Tempo de Resposta), propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Código e Padrões: Escrever e manter código limpo, testável e bem documentado, especialmente nas custom actions do Rasa (Python) e nos scripts do BLiP (JavaScript/Node.js).
  • Versionamento e CI/CD: Garantir o controle de versão com Git e auxiliar na manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD para automação do deploy do bot.
  • Documentação: Manter a documentação técnica da arquitetura, integrações e procedimentos de manutenção.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e, principalmente, na sustentação (manutenção) de chatbots nas plataformas BLiP e Rasa.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python e JavaScript/Node.js.
  • Domínio na utilização (consumo) de APIs REST/RESTful e Webhooks.
  • Conhecimento em NLP/NLU (treinamento, curadoria e fine-tuning de Intents e Entities).
  • Experiência com Git e familiaridade com conceitos de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática com Docker.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL).
  • Resolução de Problemas (Troubleshooting): Capacidade analítica para identificar, diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos em produção de forma eficaz.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum e/ou Kanban.


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:

  • Experiência com curadoria de dados conversacionais e otimização do dataset de treinamento.
  • Domínio na criação de APIs REST/RESTful do zero.
  • Conhecimento e experiência com bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis) para armazenamento de contexto e dados conversacionais.
  • Familiaridade com orquestração de containers (ex: Kubernetes) para deploy de Rasa em escala.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering e integração de Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) em fluxos de chatbot.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) para hospedagem de serviços de apoio.


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD

title: Quality Assurance Tester
description:
Position: Manual QA Tester

Location: Remote (EST hours)

Duration: 6 month contract + extensions

Pay: $15 USD per hour


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in manual software testing.
  • Familiarity with User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
  • Experience with Integration testing using Soap UI and Postman
  • Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC.
  • Experience with test case management tools
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and documentation abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Must have their own equipment*


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience testing Salesforce Field Service
  • Familiarity with Copado or DevOps tools.
  • Knowledge of CMMS systems like IBM Maximo is a plus.
  • Understanding Facilities Management


Job Summary:

We are looking for a meticulous and detail-oriented Manual QA Tester to join our quality assurance team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for manually testing software applications to ensure they meet functional and performance requirements. This team will be assisting with Sprint Testing, which will involve going through development/acceptance criteria.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review and analyze system specifications and business requirements.
  • Develop detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases.
  • Execute manual test cases and document results.
  • Identify, record, and track bugs using tools (currently using Copado which is a DevOps tool)
  • Perform manual and user acceptance testing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Provide feedback on usability, functionality, and performance.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement.

title: Assistente de auditoria - TI
description:
Responsabilidades:


  • Apoiar na extração e análise de dados para auditorias internas, identificando inconsistências e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos auditados.
  • Desenvolver, atualizar e gerenciar dashboards e relatórios interativos no Power BI, facilitando a visualização e comunicação de insights relevantes.
  • Automatizar processos de análise de dados utilizando Python, otimizando fluxos de trabalho e aumentando a eficiência das auditorias.
  • Aplicar o ACL para realização de testes de controle e análises detalhadas de conformidade .
  • Colaborar ativamente com a equipe de auditoria para identificar e documentar riscos , propondo recomendações que fortaleçam os controles internos.
  • Auxiliar o gerente de auditoria de TI na avaliação da efetividade dos controles de Cybersecurity , contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos relacionados à segurança da informação.



Requisitos:


  • Graduação concluída ou em andamento nas áreas de Análise de Dados, Tecnologia/Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou outros cursos correlatos.
  • Experiência prática no uso de Power BI, Python e ACL para análise de dados e automação de processos.

  • Conduzir melhorias contínuas em segurança de identidades e acessos.

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em gestão e hardening de AD/Entra ID .
  • Certificações: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator e/ou Azure Security Engineer .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos governamentais ou ambientes críticos.
  • Vivência com frameworks de segurança (Zero Trust, NIST, MITRE ATT&CK).

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We have an immediate contract requirement for Senior Data Engineer with one of our direct clients in USA. Contract and Remote job (Need to support during EST business hours).


About the Job duties

● Construct data pipelines using Airflow and Cloud Functions to meet business

requirements set on from the Product and Engineering teams

● Maintain and optimize table schemas, views, and queries in our data warehouse and

databases

● Perform ad-hoc analysis to troubleshoot stakeholder issues surrounding data and

provide insights into feature usage

● Develop workflows and integrations with data partners to expand our data capabilities

● Document data architecture and integration efforts to provide a clear understanding of

the data platform to other team members

● Provide guidance on data best practices when building out new product lines

● Automate long running manual processes to free up internal resources

● Create scalable framework for onboarding new data partners

Must have

● Experience with data task orchestration (Airflow, CRON, Prefect etc..) with dependency

mapping

● Data analysis and data modeling

● Strong experience in Python, SQL, shell scripting

● Experience interacting with APIs, SFTP, Cloud Storage locations (eg. GCS, s3)

● Analytical problem solving skills, ability to analyze application logs to troubleshoot issues

● Familiarity with Cloud Computing (GCP a plus)

Nice to have

● Experience with Javascript

● Hands on work with Airflow

● ML/MLOps

● Docker and K8s

● NoSQL

● Exposure to producer/consumer messaging systems



Some additional notes from our consultant onsite


Essential skills:

  • SQL
  • Python
  • Git
  • Apache Airflow (or other orchestrators such as Dagster or Prefect)

Nice-to-have skills:

  • Node.js or JavaScript
  • Google BigQuery
  • Event-driven serverless cloud functions (Google Cloud Functions, AWS Lambda or Azure Functions)
  • Asynchronous event-driven messaging (Google Cloud Pub/Sub, AWS SNS, AWS SQS, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid or Azure Storage Queues)
  • Object storage: either cloud-based (Google Cloud Storage, AWS S3 or Azure Blob Storage) or on-premises (e.g., MinIO, Ceph)


Bachelor's degree required.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant


Location : Remote

Role : Full-Time

Compensation : $1,008 USD / month


Overview

We’re seeking a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to support a founder overseeing multiple businesses and a large, fast-moving team. This role blends operations, project management, and communication — turning chaos into clarity, ensuring follow-through, and building the systems that keep everything running smoothly.


You’ll manage day-to-day execution, organize documentation and data, maintain visibility across key projects, and serve as a force multiplier to the executive’s productivity and bandwidth.


Key Responsibilities


Operational & Project Management

  • Oversee and track multiple ongoing initiatives across departments using ClickUp, ensuring deliverables, deadlines, and ownership are clear.
  • Build and maintain SOPs, documentation, and internal knowledge bases (Notion or similar) that standardize workflows and improve team clarity.
  • Continuously structure, update, and optimize company systems to eliminate inefficiencies.
  • Handle follow-ups, reminders, and accountability loops to keep tasks moving without executive oversight.


Communication & Coordination

  • Serve as the primary bridge between the executive and internal teams — triaging requests, gathering updates, and maintaining alignment.
  • Take detailed meeting notes, capture decisions, and prepare agendas or materials for upcoming meetings.
  • Own internal communications, ensuring important updates, deliverables, and initiatives are clearly shared across leadership and teams.
  • Manage scheduling, meetings, and external correspondence with precision and professionalism.


Research & Development

  • Conduct research and development on outsourced tasks, tools, vendors, and new business ideas — summarizing findings into clear insights and next steps.
  • Anticipate needs by proactively identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and presenting streamlined processes or automations.


KPI Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain and update KPI dashboards across departments (Google Sheets, Airtable, or similar).
  • Analyze trends, highlight bottlenecks, and surface insights to improve operational performance.
  • Help standardize data reporting processes to ensure accuracy and consistency across business units.


Finance & Administration

  • Support light bookkeeping and accounting — including expense tracking, payroll coordination, and invoice organization.
  • Liaise with the accounting team to ensure financial data is reconciled and documented properly.
  • Maintain organized file systems for contracts, invoices, and critical documents.


Execution & Ownership

  • Take full ownership of low-leverage tasks — research, outreach, scheduling, document organization — freeing the executive to focus on high-impact initiatives.
  • Operate with high initiative and accountability, driving projects forward without constant direction.
  • Protect executive time by managing priorities, anticipating needs, and proactively solving problems before they arise.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Manager, or Project Coordinator in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong command of Notion, ClickUp, Google Sheets, and other organizational tools.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple moving parts.
  • Analytical and tech-fluent — able to interpret data and implement process improvements.
  • Demonstrated initiative, work ethic, and confidentiality in working directly with senior leadership.


You’ll Thrive If You

  • Naturally bring order to chaos and create structure where there is none.
  • Anticipate needs instead of waiting for direction.
  • Love building systems, documenting processes, and keeping projects organized.
  • Take pride in making complex operations run smoothly behind the scenes.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Senior
description:
Engenheiro de dados com conhecimento em Python


Modelo de contratação PJ


Como será o dia a dia:


  • Desenvolver com autonomia, confiança, segurança e qualidade.
  • Dar suporte e direcionamento aos demais desenvolvedores.
  • Analisar o Pull Request e fazer o Code Review.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs.
  • Permanecer no canal junto com a squad, se comunicar, ajudar e solicitar ajuda quando necessário.
  • Dar continuidade nas demandas no Jira.
  • Testar os fluxos dos códigos, garantindo as entregas e que elas não atrapalhem o trabalho dos outros colegas.
  • Participar da validação e verificação de requisitos do projeto.
  • Escrever códigos que os outros possam ler e dar continuidade, deixando bem documentado.
  • Escrever código limpo, legível e escalável, seguindo boas práticas de programação e padrões de design.
  • Escrever testes eficientes e confiáveis, cobrindo diferentes cenários e fluxos de execução.


Conhecimento:


  • Estrutura de dados;
  • Versionamento com Git;
  • Frameworks de testes;
  • Airflow;
  • Python.
  • Apache Spark → Processamento distribuído de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Apache Kafka → Streaming de dados em tempo real e integração de sistemas.
  • . Data Lakehouse & Data Warehouse → Arquiteturas modernas de dados (Delta Lake, Iceberg).

DevOps Engineer

International job opportunity!!

5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar.

Strong proficiency with AWS and infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).

Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

Solid scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar).

Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or other container orchestration platforms.

Experience with monitoring and alerting tools (Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch, etc.).

Knowledge of networking, security, and cloud architecture best practices.

Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative remote environment.


❗❗ Nice to Have

Experience with serverless (Lambda, API Gateway).

Knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001, etc.).

Familiarity with automotive or insurance tech ecosystems.

We’re seeking a highly experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to help drive the scalability, security, and reliability of our cloud-based infrastructure. You’ll play a pivotal role in building CI/CD pipelines, automating deployments, improving monitoring, and helping define the DevOps roadmap for our growing product ecosystem.

Manage code merges for multiple projects sharing code base. Manage and automate moves to production. Consult on AWS infra design

Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure (preferably in AWS).

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar.

Define infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.

Monitor systems performance and ensure high availability and disaster recovery.

Collaborate closely with backend engineers, QA, and product teams to streamline deployments.

Implement and enforce security best practices across all environments.

Automate repetitive tasks to improve efficiency and reduce human error.

title: Tech Lead | Engenheiro de IA (LLM)
description:
#VemPraTrinks


A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.


Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:


  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.


O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:


  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento em LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).


Será um diferencial se você conhecer:


  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.


Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:


100% Home office;

⏳ Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Analista de exportação Jr
description:
Consultoria em exportação em parceria com a Envolve RH, contrata:


Analista de Exportação Jr (PJ /Remoto)


Desenho de atuação:

  • Atuar na gestão completa dos processos de exportação, assegurando conformidade legal, eficiência logística e alinhamento com a estratégia de crescimento internacional da empresa;
  • Emitir, conferir e controlar a documentação essencial (Invoice, Packing List, Certificados de Origem, Certificados Sanitários, BL/AWB);
  • Atuar na resolução de entraves alfandegários, garantindo fluidez dos despachos.
  • Coordenar projetos de marca própria, alinhando com o cliente o MOQ de embalagem e a adequação regulatória para cada país, em interface com os departamentos de Marketing, Qualidade e demais áreas envolvidas;
  • Gestão de Compliance e Regulamentação Monitorar barreiras tarifárias e não tarifárias, sanções e requisitos regulatórios internacionais. Interagir com órgãos governamentais e entidades regulatórias para obtenção de certificações e autorizações;
  • Gestão de Fornecedores e Parceiros Negociar com transportadoras, despachantes, agentes de carga e operadores logísticos. Avaliar e homologar fornecedores logísticos, assegurando qualidade e confiabilidade. Controlar documentos financeiros (a pagar / a receber) relacionados às exportações.
  • Analisar regimes alfandegários e cambiais, garantindo correto enquadramento tributário.


O que buscamos:

  • Conhecimento sólido em procedimentos e regulamentações de exportação;
  • Experiência prática com documentação e processos aduaneiros;
  • Familiaridade com ERP, Siscomex, Mercante, DU-E e regimes especiais;
  • Domínio de Incoterms, negociação internacional e precificação para exportação;
  • Excel avançado (dashboards, controles e análises);
  • Fluência em inglês e espanhol;
  • Graduação em Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios Internacionais é um diferencial;
  • Necessário disponibilidade de horário, muitas negociações acontecem fora do expediente, devido à natureza do negócio (diferentes fusos horários), para dar andamento ao processo;
  • Será um diferencial conhecer gerenciador de tarefas (Trello).


O que oferecemos:

  • Remuneração Fixa mais variável;
  • Observações: Modelo PJ/ Home Office;
  • Proposta de remuneração envolve fixo mais variável praticado em resultado do negócio e entrega.
